say:4:1041502602:1.text: Yes... When I first got here, I felt somewhat out of place... so I was a bit nervous.
say:4:1041502602:1.source_cn: 嗯……一开始来的时候，感觉有点陌生……所以我有些紧张。

say:5:1041502603:1.text: But once I'd stayed long enough, it began to feel special. My heart is warm now.
say:5:1041502603:1.source_cn: 但是，待久了以后，就觉得很特别，感觉心都暖暖的。

say:6:1041502604:1.text: The feeling is like listening to the rain on a warm summer night... refreshing... comforting.
say:6:1041502604:1.source_cn: 就好像在夏天的傍晚下过一场刚好的雨一样……很清爽，又很...

say:9:1041502606:1.text: I, uh, accidentally overheard Miss Lyca say she wanted to offer the Deer Spirit some fresh dew...
say:9:1041502606:1.source_cn: 那个，我之前无意中听到，莱卡小姐说，想要给鹿灵供奉一些...

say:10:1041502607:1.text: So I got some, b-but will it be rude of me to deliver it directly?
say:10:1041502607:1.source_cn: 我特意准备了一些，但、但是，这样子送过去会不会有些突兀……

choice_prompt:11:1041502607.text: So I got some, b-but will it be rude of me to deliver it directly?
choice_prompt:11:1041502607.source_cn: 我特意准备了一些，但、但是，这样子送过去会不会有些突兀……

say:12:1041502608:1.text: Really? But I'm a little nervous to speak up... would you mind helping me?
say:12:1041502608:1.source_cn: 真的吗？但我还是有点不敢开口……能不能拜托您帮忙……

say:13:1041502610:1.text: Morning. Can I help you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... huh? Hewynn is here, too?
say:13:1041502610:1.male: Morning. Can I help you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... huh? Hewynn is here, too?
say:13:1041502610:1.female: Morning. Can I help you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>... huh? Hewynn is here, too?

say:14:1041502611:1.text: Fancy seeing you outside of Lovers' Wish! It's nice here too, isn't it? Lively and cozy as well!
say:14:1041502611:1.source_cn: 真巧啊，难得见到你离开情人之愿，在这里也不错吧？很热闹...

choice_prompt:15:1041502611.text: Fancy seeing you outside of Lovers' Wish! It's nice here too, isn't it? Lively and cozy as well!
choice_prompt:15:1041502611.source_cn: 真巧啊，难得见到你离开情人之愿，在这里也不错吧？很热闹，也很舒服！

say:16:1041502612:1.text: A gift? Oh, you shouldn't have...

say:17:1041502613:1.text: So I heard about Misarte and the Deer Spirit's blessing. Didn't you mention you need fresh dew, Lyca?
say:17:1041502613:1.source_cn: 嗯，之前听到了弥萨忒与鹿灵祝福的传闻……然后莱卡你之前...

say:18:1041502614:1.text: I-I have some blessed refined dew here and, uh, was wondering if...
say:18:1041502614:1.source_cn: 我、我这里有一些经过祝福和提炼的凝露，不知道可不可以……

say:19:1041502615:1.text: Of course! That's a great help! Thank you, Hewynn!
say:19:1041502615:1.source_cn: 当然可以！帮大忙了！谢谢你，伊温！

say:20:1041502616:1.text: I've tried spring water and some from Lunnos Lake before. Even though it was blessed, I'd like to try something more pure, like dew...
say:20:1041502616:1.source_cn: 我之前试过泉水和月湖水，虽然都有祝福，但我觉得还是应该...

say:21:1041502617:1.text: Lorsan suggested collecting morning dew from petals, but I spent several days filling up just half a bottle, and dirt from the flowers mixed in...
say:21:1041502617:1.source_cn: 洛桑建议我从花瓣上收集晨露，但我花了好几天才采满半瓶，...

say:22:1041502618:1.text: Right, because flower petals and leaves are exposed to wind and rain, they often have a lot of dirt on them. To get pure dew, we need to extract it with magic...
say:22:1041502618:1.source_cn: 是、是的，花瓣和叶片因为风吹雨打，会有很多泥土的，想要...

say:23:1041502619:1.text: And if not using magic, you need a vessel appropriate to the area of collection.
say:23:1041502619:1.source_cn: 不用魔力的话，就要适当地选择收集的容器……

choice_prompt:24:1041502619.text: And if not using magic, you need a vessel appropriate to the area of collection.
choice_prompt:24:1041502619.source_cn: 不用魔力的话，就要适当地选择收集的容器……

say:25:1041502620:1.text: Hmm, I see. I didn't realize it could be collected like this... I'll go try it out right away!
say:25:1041502620:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯，原来如此，居然能这样采集啊……我马上就回去试试！

choice:15:0:1.text: Hewynn has a gift for you.
choice:15:0:1.male: Hewynn has a gift for you.
choice:15:0:1.female: Hewynn has a gift for you.
